Rambukwella Sri Vipassi Development F: (Incorporation) Act, No. 18 of 2007
to  render  assistance  to  Buddhists  in  awarding
scholarships,  maintaining  dhamma  schools,
maintaining  libraries,  centres  for  Buddhist
information and research and maintaining electronic
centres ;
to provide economic relief needed to raise the living
standards of the Buddhists through the development
of their physical and mental well being ;
to  provide  relief  services  for  the  destitute  and  to
maintain elders homes and rest rooms ;

to 
initiate  projects 
in  order 
to  create 
job
opportunities for the Buddhists who are unemployed
and to provide aid, facilities and other loan facilities
for that purpose ;
to  organize  vocational  training  courses  and  to
develop  skills  in  order  to  facilitate  securing  of
employment ;
to render assistance to industries and to maintain a
pilgrims  rest  for  the  convenience  of  Buddhist
pilgrims who travel through the area to visit places
of traditional religious workshop ; and
to  print,  publish  and  distribute  books,  journals,
leaflets,  newspapers  and  magazines  which  the
Corporation  may  consider  desirable  for  the
promotion and advancement of its objects referred
to in the above paragraphs.
